entries.tutorialSubtitle: Why the 6 to 9 mm gap controls everything in a managed hive, and how to keep your equipment working with it.

A shallow serving bowl carved from a prepared seasoned blank with gouges and an inshave is a manageable first bowl project; the blank is pre-dimensioned, the walls are not too thin, and beech holds an edge cleanly without tearing. entries.tutorialExcerpt: Contact printing, also called eco-printing, places plant material directly against damp fabric, bundles it tightly, and steams or simmers it. Heat and pressure transfer plant pigments and tannins to the cloth surface, leaving ghost prints of the plant's shape and colour. The dough is made with a yeast enrichment and then folded with cold butter in the same way as croissant dough, producing layers that puff up into a distinctly flaky, crisp exterior with a soft, yeasted crumb. Finished with a simple icing sugar glaze.

entries.tutorialSubtitle: Building a self-composting floor in a chicken coop to cut mucking-out frequency through the winter months.

entries.tutorialSubtitle: French whole-egg sponge base for layered and filled cakes
entries.tutorialExcerpt: A light, fine-crumbed sponge built by whisking whole eggs and sugar together over heat until pale and thick, then folding in sifted flour and melted butter. It has no chemical leavening: all the lift comes from the aerated eggs. The locked crossing prevents threads from shifting, creating an open, stable mesh from widely spaced warps.
